recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR-50443 follow-up is needed unless OO later chooses to regenerate or replace the diagram from its diagram source-of-truth as a separate human-reviewed presentation update.
issue_request: FHIR-50443 was an Applied, Persuasive OO change request for R6 asking the Device module diagram to show DeviceDispense.basedOn pointing to DeviceRequest, DeviceDispense.device pointing to Device, and DeviceDispense.subject pointing first to Patient and optionally Practitioner; the resolution was to include all proposed relationships, including Practitioner.
initial_application: No source commit naming FHIR-50443 was found. Jira says it was applied in FHIR-50445; HL7/fhir PR #3836 and commit ff73a37610 added images/DeviceModule.svg, registered DeviceModule.svg in publish.ini, and updated source/device-module.html to use the SVG and clarify that the diagram shows representative relationships.
additional_context: source/device-module.html is active through source/hierarchy.xml and publish.ini, and publish.ini registers DeviceModule.svg as a published image. FHIR-50445 and FHIR-50444 are already represented on the combined branch with no-change audits for the same diagram update family. FHIR-50439 is related to Observation relationships in the same replacement diagram but was not needed to decide this seed.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current build-scoped module page points to the applied SVG, and rendering the SVG confirmed the requested DeviceDispense diagram relationships are present, so no source edit is needed.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-50443's Jira comment says the DeviceDispense pointer change was applied in FHIR-50445, whose PR #3836 added the current DeviceModule.svg and page wording; FHIR-50445 is already audited on the combined branch.
It concerns labels and interpretation of the same Device module diagram and is already audited on the combined branch.
It concerns Observation relationships in the same replacement diagram, but was not decided here because the seed decision did not require auditing that Observation-specific scope.
PR #3836 also carried adjacent Device module use-case text and that issue is already represented on the combined branch.
